historyQuery.successSemantics: A nonnull expectedHistoryRevision retains the exact current CAS query; null requests a fresh, authorized, read-only durable HistoryView snapshot of the current object and linked history heads. An event is not a substitute for that snapshot.
validationOrder: nonnull expected history revision CAS or null current durable snapshot
linked entry integrity and complete committed snapshot
historyQuery.idempotency: nonnull retains requestId+exact validated payload replay semantics; null is a fresh authorized durable read on every call, never a cached event or stale replay

fresh authorized Canvas current history snapshot
operations.idempotency: read-only; requestId correlates one fresh authorized durable read, not a cached replay
